newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's health minister resigns - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's health minister resigns - paper.

text.p: Kuwait's Health Minister Anwar al-Nouri said he had resigned for private reasons, a newspaper reported on Thursday.
"Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah understands the private reasons for the resignation," Al-Rai al-Aam newspaper quoted Nouri as saying.
Officials were not available for immediate comment.
Nouri was appointed in October 30 two weeks after the formation of the cabinet.
